http_contract.base: /api/v1/admin/sellers (inherits appAuthMiddleware + requireAdmin from admin/index.ts; every route requires Authorization: Bearer <hub access token>, which is also the Hub actor token)
http_contract.SellerRow: { id: uuid, accountId: string|null, displayName: string, contactEmail: string, status: 'active'|'inactive', createdAt: ISO, updatedAt: ISO|null, invitationId: string|null, invitationStatus: 'pending'|'accepted'|'expired'|'revoked'|null, invitedOrgId: string|null }
http_contract.InvitationDelivery: { invitation: HubInvitation { id, organizationId, applicationId, email, status, appRoles: string[], invitedByAccountId: string|null, expiresAt: ISO, createdAt: ISO, acceptedAt: ISO|null }, acceptUrl: string (single-use, display only, never log), emailDelivery: { status: 'sent'|'not_configured'|'failed' }, warnings: Array<{ code: 'application_url_missing'|'email_not_configured'|'email_failed' }> }
http_contract.InvitationErrorBody: { error: string, code: HubInvitationErrorCode | 'unknown' | 'hub_auth_not_configured' | 'seller_not_invited', message?: string (pt-BR INVITATION_COPY; absent on hub_auth_not_configured and seller_not_invited) }

routes.behaviour: Lists sellers newest first. When the invitations client is present and at least one seller has an invitationId, calls client.list({ accessToken, status }) once per status (pending, accepted, expired, revoked; the Hub list answers one status per call and defaults to pending, so a single list() could never surface accepted/expired), and persists any changed invitationStatus before returning. List failure or no client: persisted state, no error.

routes.request_body: { displayName: string (2..100), contactEmail: email, locale?: 'pt-BR'|'en' (default 'pt-BR') }; any other key (organizationId, accessToken, ...) is ignored
routes.behaviour: Inserts the seller, then client.create({ accessToken: <bearer>, email: contactEmail, appRoles: ['seller'], locale }). On success persists invitationId, invitationStatus='pending', invitedOrgId=c.get('orgId'). The seller is never rolled back.

responses.body: { seller: SellerRow, invitation, acceptUrl, emailDelivery, warnings } (InvitationDelivery spread at top level)
{ seller: SellerRow, inviteError: { status: number (the HTTP status mapInvitationError assigns: 400|401|403|404|409|429|500|502|503), error, code, message, retryAfterSeconds?: number } }
responses.headers: Retry-After: <seconds> when the Hub rate-limited with a Retry-After

responses.case: no invitations client (no Hub config or dev identity mode)
responses.body: { seller: SellerRow, inviteError: { status: 503, error: 'unavailable', code: 'hub_auth_not_configured' } }
{ seller, inviteError: { status: 500, error: 'internal_error', code: 'unknown', message: INVITATION_COPY.configurationDefect } }

routes.request_body: optional { locale?: 'pt-BR'|'en' } (default 'pt-BR'); an absent body is fine
routes.behaviour: client.resend({ accessToken: <bearer>, invitationId: <stored>, locale }); persists the returned invitation.id and invitation.status.

responses.body: { seller: SellerRow, invitation, acceptUrl, emailDelivery, warnings }

routes.behaviour: client.revoke({ accessToken: <bearer>, invitationId: <stored> }); then invitationStatus='revoked'. No DELETE verb exists.

checks.command: pnpm exec vitest run src/domains/sellers/__tests__/seller-invite.test.ts (RED, before impl)

manual mutations (each reverted): appRoles+admin, organizationId in create body, invitedOrgId constant, rethrow on create failure (rollback-equivalent), single list() call, non-header bearer, drop Retry-After

notes: POST / always answers 201 because the seller row exists; a failed invite rides as `inviteError` with `status` = the HTTP status mapInvitationError (or INVITATIONS_UNAVAILABLE) assigns, plus Retry-After header and retryAfterSeconds when rate-limited. This keeps the existing web createSeller contract ({ seller }) working and lets slice 09 offer resend.

GET / reconciliation deviates from the literal 'client.list({ accessToken })': the SDK documents that an absent status means the Hub's default (pending), so one call per status is made (Promise.allSettled; any fulfilled status reconciles, all failing = persisted fallback). Only rows whose status changed are UPDATEd. Matching is by stored invitation id; invitations from another Organization simply do not appear and keep their persisted status.

Bearer is read in the route handler: (Authorization ?? '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim(); never body, never hubAuth. The test sets hubAuth with a different workspace to prove neither org nor token comes from it.
Resend/revoke check the client first (503 before any DB read), then seller existence (non-uuid ids answer 404 instead of a Postgres 22P02), then the stored invitationId (409 seller_not_invited).

Logging: only error NAME (non-Hub errors) or HubInvitationError.code (list failures) is logged; the route-level test spies console.log/info/warn/error/debug/trace across create, resend and a failing create whose error message contains the acceptUrl, and asserts neither the accept token nor the bearer reaches any call.
The unit test mocks getAdminDb with an in-memory fake and replaces drizzle-orm `eq` (partial mock keeping the rest) so the fake can resolve `where(eq(sellers.id, x))`.
